patthana8.73:1.1: na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.73:2.1: na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana8.73:3.1: na sauttarañca na anuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
